scope: Remediate only the session-1750 consolidation catalog by reconciling every workaround-null entry that overlaps the resolved const-qualification and per-object compiler-setting lesson records. Record the remaining exact-function workaround-null residue as pre-existing catalog debt. No source, progress accounting, or frontier change is made.

catalog.superseded_reconciliation_command: jq -r '. as $root | [$root.lessons[] | select(.workaround != null) | select(.evidence | any(. == "docs/matching.md: External object qualifiers affect first-load scheduling" or . == "docs/matching.md: Per-object compiler settings in the audio code")) | .functions[]] | unique as $resolved | [$root.lessons[] | select(.workaround == null) | .functions[] | select(. as $fn | $resolved | index($fn))] | unique | "resolved_lesson_functions=\($resolved|length) superseded_unresolved_functions=\(length)"' reports/GEDE01/lessons.json
catalog.late_audio_precision_command: jq -r '[.lessons[] | select(.category=="register-allocation" and (.evidence | any(contains("session-1714") or contains("session-1718") or contains("session-1721") or contains("session-1724") or contains("session-1727") or contains("session-1735") or contains("session-1736") or contains("session-1737") or contains("session-1738") or contains("session-1748")))) | .functions|length] | "late_audio_register_entries=\(length) multi_function_entries=\([.[]|select(.>1)]|length)"' reports/GEDE01/lessons.json

known_gap.scope: Exact functions outside the resolved lesson records that remain in workaround-null catalog entries are pre-existing debt and were not edited in this remediation.
known_gap.command: jq -s -r '.[0] as $catalog | .[1] as $report | [$report.units[] | .functions[]? | select(.fuzzy_match_percent == 100) | .name] | unique as $exact | [$catalog.lessons[] | select(.workaround == null) | .functions[] | select(. as $fn | $exact | index($fn))] | unique | "exact_functions_still_in_null_workaround_entries=\(length)"' reports/GEDE01/lessons.json build/GEDE01/session-1750-remediation-1-reloc-strict.json

scalar_extern_commit_evidence.command: git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r 016c5c65b -- 'src/game/game_fn_*.c' | sort; git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r 016c5c65b -- 'src/game/game_fn_*.c' | wc -l | tr -d ' ' | sed 's/^/changed_function_sources=/'
